settings.title: Melt-safe summers
settings.text: Chocolate and fudge ship with cold packs from May through September.

settings.title: Arrives right, or we resend
settings.text: Crushed, melted or leaking? Send a photo and we'll replace it. Nothing to send back.

settings.question: How fast do you ship?
settings.answer: Orders placed by 1 p.m. ET Monday–Friday ship the same or next business day from Michigan. Ground takes 1–6 business days, and Priority and Express are offered at checkout.

settings.question: Will chocolate and fudge melt?
settings.answer: From May through September, we pack chocolate and fudge with cold packs and ship early in the week so they don't sit in a warehouse over the weekend. If anything arrives melted, send us a photo and we'll replace it.

settings.question: How do you ship Faygo and Vernors without a mess?
settings.answer: Every can is wrapped and packed upright in a divider. In deep-freeze weeks we may hold pop for a few days so cans don't burst in transit.

settings.question: Can I include a gift message? Are prices in the box?
settings.answer: Yes. Add a note in the cart and we write it on a Michigan postcard by hand. We never put prices or receipts in a gift box.

settings.question: Why can't I get Hudsonville, Koegel's or Bumpy Cake?
settings.answer: They need to stay frozen or refrigerated, and we only ship things that arrive tasting right. Our boxes are 100% shelf-stable.

settings.question: Do you do corporate or bulk gifts?
settings.answer: Yes, for 10 boxes or more. Send one spreadsheet of addresses, add your logo card, and get volume pricing. Get a quote.
